description: Branch protection requires two contexts and the caller's --required-context names only one — the plausible mistake of overriding with the context you happen to be thinking about. Both named-and-omitted contexts here are green, so a watcher that let the override replace protection outright would report a perfectly confident pass over a strict subset of the real gate. The verdict must be query-error: the override is checked against protection rather than trusted in place of it.
